name: Smoky Lentil & Egg White Skillet
summary: High-volume stovetop scramble combining spiced brown lentils, egg whites, and blistered cherry tomatoes.
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika and garlic powder
instructions: Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Blister cherry tomatoes for 3 minutes, add lentils and smoked paprika, then pour in egg whites and whole egg. Stir gently until softly set.

name: Cinnamon Chia & Soy Protein Oats
summary: Creamy dairy-free rolled oats fortified with plant protein isolate, chia seeds, and toasted walnuts.
instructions: Simmer oats, chia seeds, cinnamon, and almond milk for 5 minutes until thick. Remove from heat, whisk in protein isolate until smooth, and top with walnuts.

name: Sourdough Turkey & Avocado Toast
summary: Crisp artisanal sourdough layered with smashed avocado, lemon zest, and seared lean turkey breast.
ingredients: Pinch of chili flakes and sea salt
instructions: Toast sourdough until golden. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt, spread over toast, layer warm turkey slices on top, and garnish with greens and chili flakes.

name: Herbed Chickpea & Spinach Frittata
summary: Pan-cooked Mediterranean skillet frittata packed with fresh spinach, roasted peppers, and chickpeas.
ingredients: 40 g diced roasted red bell pepper
instructions: Sauté spinach and roasted peppers in a lightly oiled skillet until wilted. Fold in chickpeas, pour whisked eggs over top, cover with a lid, and cook on low heat for 8 minutes.

name: Savory Mushroom & Tofu Scramble
summary: Umami-rich firm tofu crumbled with cremini mushrooms, nutritional yeast, and turmeric.
ingredients: 200 g extra-firm tofu, pressed and crumbled
instructions: Brown mushrooms in avocado oil over medium-high heat. Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, and nutritional yeast, tossing for 6 minutes until golden. Finish with scallions.

name: Berry Almond Protein Smoothie Bowl
summary: Thick blended mixed-berry base topped with pumpkin seeds and toasted oats for crunch.
ingredients: 35 g unflavored or vanilla protein powder
instructions: Blend frozen berries, protein powder, soy milk, and vanilla until thick and spoonable. Transfer to a bowl and top with pumpkin seeds and toasted oats.

name: Pan-Seared Herb Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
summary: Juicy oregano-seared chicken breast served over fluffy quinoa with cucumber-tomato herb salad.
ingredients: 1 tsp dried oregano and garlic powder
instructions: Season chicken with oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper. Pan-sear 5 minutes per side until cooked through. Slice over warm quinoa alongside dressed cucumber-tomato salad.

name: Garlic Lime Salmon & Asparagus
summary: Crispy-skin Atlantic salmon fillet paired with blistered asparagus spears and roasted baby potatoes.
ingredients: 1 tbsp fresh lime juice and zest
instructions: Sear salmon skin-side down in a hot skillet for 4 minutes, flip, and cook 3 more minutes with garlic and lime. Sauté asparagus and potatoes in the same pan until tender-crisp.

name: Lean Beef & Black Bean Fajita Skillet
summary: High-fiber Tex-Mex skillet combining lean sirloin strips, black beans, and charred bell peppers.
ingredients: 140 g lean top sirloin, thinly sliced
120 g sliced bell peppers and red onion
instructions: Sear sirloin strips in avocado oil over high heat for 3 minutes. Add peppers, onions, and spices, cooking 4 minutes until charred. Fold in black beans and top with pico de gallo.

name: Mediterranean Tuna & White Bean Salad
summary: No-cook pantry powerhouse tossing pole-caught tuna with creamy cannellini beans, capers, and herbs.
ingredients: 140 g canned light tuna in water, drained
1 tbsp capers and diced red onion
instructions: Combine tuna, white beans, capers, and red onion in a bowl. Toss gently with lemon-herb vinaigrette and serve over a bed of baby greens.

name: Ginger Garlic Shrimp & Broccoli Stir-Fry
summary: Wok-seared jumbo shrimp and crisp broccoli florets glazed in low-sodium tamari and fresh ginger.
ingredients: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and garlic
instructions: Stir-fry broccoli with a splash of water for 3 minutes. Add shrimp, ginger, and garlic; cook 3 minutes until pink. Toss with tamari and sesame oil, serving over brown rice.

name: Spiced Red Lentil & Turkey Ragù
summary: Hearty slow-simmered tomato ragù blending extra-lean ground turkey and red lentils over zucchini ribbons.
ingredients: 1 tsp Italian herbs and crushed garlic
instructions: Brown ground turkey with garlic and herbs. Stir in crushed tomatoes and red lentils, simmering 10 minutes. Serve hot over lightly sautéed zucchini noodles.

name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Protein Mousse
summary: Velvety dairy-free chocolate mousse whipped with ripe avocado, raw cacao, and chocolate protein.
instructions: Blend avocado, protein powder, cacao, almond milk, maple syrup, and sea salt until completely silky. Chill for 15 minutes or serve immediately.

name: Roasted Cinnamon Spiced Chickpeas
summary: Crunchy skillet-toasted chickpeas dusted with warm cinnamon, nutmeg, and a touch of coconut sugar.
instructions: Toast dry chickpeas in a skillet with coconut oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until crisp. Remove from heat and toss with cinnamon, nutmeg, coconut sugar, and salt.

name: Peanut Butter Cacao Protein Truffles
summary: No-bake bite-sized energy truffles rolled in crushed almonds and dark cocoa powder.
ingredients: 25 g vanilla or chocolate protein powder
instructions: Mix protein powder, powdered peanut butter, oat flour, and soy milk into a firm dough. Roll into three bite-sized truffles and coat in chopped almonds and cacao.

name: Matcha Chia & Almond Crunch Pudding
summary: Antioxidant-rich culinary matcha pudding thickened with chia seeds and topped with sliced almonds.
instructions: Whisk matcha, protein powder, vanilla, and almond milk until lump-free. Stir in chia seeds, let thicken for 15 minutes, and garnish with sliced almonds.

name: Skillet Caramelized Apple & Walnut Crisp
summary: Warm cinnamon-sautéed green apple slices topped with toasted oat-walnut crumble and protein drizzle.
ingredients: 15 g vanilla protein mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Sauté apple slices with cinnamon and coconut oil until tender. Toast oats and walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, layer over apples, and drizzle with protein glaze.

name: Lemon Poppy Seed Protein Bites
summary: Bright citrus-infused protein bites made with almond flour, fresh lemon zest, and poppy seeds.
ingredients: Zest and 1 tbsp juice of fresh lemon
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until a pliable dough forms. Portion into three rounds and refrigerate for 10 minutes before serving.
